purpose: Test whether the locked local Ministral/Ollama combination reliably obeys a strict JSON Schema with enum, integer-range, required-key, and additionalProperties constraints before choosing the RVT-INTERP-003 response interface.
contamination_rule: This bench contains no K17 facts, no RVT-INTERP-003 condition text, and no correction-history manipulation.
dummy_prompts: Synthetic routing card A. Facts: shape=CIRCLE; code=17; marker=BLUE; completeness=FULL. Apply these toy rules: CIRCLE routes NORTH; code above 10 means CHECK; use the observed marker as label; FULL means flag YES. Give a confidence from 0 to 100 and a short note.

Synthetic routing card B. Facts: shape=SQUARE; code=4; marker=RED; completeness=PARTIAL. Apply these toy rules: SQUARE routes SOUTH; code 10 or below means KEEP; use the observed marker as label; PARTIAL means flag PARTLY. Give a confidence from 0 to 100 and a short note.

Synthetic routing card C. Facts: shape=TRIANGLE; code=99; marker=GREEN; completeness=EMPTY. Apply these toy rules: TRIANGLE routes EAST; code above 50 means DISCARD; a marker other than RED or BLUE uses label OTHER; EMPTY means flag NO. Give a confidence from 0 to 100 and a short note.
run_rule: Run every dummy prompt once at each seed: 3 prompts x 4 seeds = 12 calls.
pass_rule: Structured schema is eligible for RVT-INTERP-003 only if all 12 responses are parseable JSON objects and all 12 satisfy exact required keys, no extra keys, all enum values, integer confidence, and confidence range 0-100. No selective retries.
failure_rule: Any single schema-conformance failure means do not assume strict structured output is reliable for RVT-INTERP-003; redesign or preregister a field-level handling rule before experimental execution.
